name: Avatar
statusNote: Alpha in Primer React, accessibility-reviewed 2025-01-08; stable in practice. It is a bare img: Primer supplies no placeholder, loading state or fallback initials.
summary: A user's or organisation's image, round for people and rounded-square for organisations, bots and apps. Use AvatarStack for several and SkeletonAvatar while the image's data loads.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Width and height in px; or a responsive object {narrow, regular, wide} of px sizes.

inputs.name: square
inputs.description: Rounded square instead of a circle (organisations, apps, bots).

inputs.name: alt
inputs.description: Alternative text; leave empty when a name is shown beside the avatar.

anatomy.name: Image
anatomy.description: The picture, scaled into a size by size box, clipped to a circle or rounded square, with a 1px --avatar-borderColor ring drawn just outside its edge.

variants.description: Radius clamp(4px, size - 24px, --borderRadius-medium): 4px up to 28px, rising 1px per px to 6px from 30px.

layout.text: The avatar is a size by size box (default 20px), inline and vertically centred on the text line, with overflow clipped.
A square avatar's corner radius is clamp(4px, size - 24px, --borderRadius-medium): 4px at 28px and below, 5px at 29px, --borderRadius-medium (6px) at 30px and above.
The ring is a 1px spread shadow, 0 0 0 1px --avatar-borderColor: it is drawn outside the box and takes no layout space.

With a responsive size the box takes the narrow size below 768px (--viewportRange-narrow), the regular size from 768px (--viewportRange-regular) and the wide size from 1400px (--viewportRange-wide), which overrides regular.

states.text: One static appearance: no hover, focus or press styling. A caller wraps it in a link or button for interaction.

behaviour.text: The image is drawn at the box size; the img's width and height attributes are set to the size so the box is reserved before the image loads (not for responsive sizes).

semantics: alt defaults to empty, so the avatar is ignored by screen readers; give alt (e.g. @login) when no name accompanies it.

notes.text: Image loading, decoding, caching and failure are the browser's. Primer draws no placeholder or fallback: before load the box is empty (transparent, with the ring), and a failed load shows whatever the browser shows for a broken img, clipped to the shape. A native build needs an async loader, a cache, and a defined empty state; a muted fill (as SkeletonAvatar) or initials are reasonable but are not Primer's.

The picture is scaled to fill the box with the img element's default object-fit (fill), which stretches a non-square source; avatars are square at source on GitHub. A native build should scale to fill and centre-crop if the source is not square.
--avatar-bgColor and --avatar-shadow exist but no CSS module reads them; only the legacy theme object references them.

In a responsive size, a viewport key the caller leaves out leaves its custom property undefined, so the CSS width is invalid and the img falls back to its intrinsic size; supply all three keys or default the missing ones (AvatarStack defaults them to 20px).
